exams.name: Journey Plumber License Examination
exams.notes: Board-administered written examination; applicant may request regrade.
exams.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this subtitle, an applicant for a master plumber license or a journey plumber license shall pass an examination given by the Board under this subtitle.

exams.name: Master Plumber License Examination
exams.notes: Examination must cover gas fitting regulations, safety, pipe sizing, mathematics, physics, plan interpretation, system design, and venting.
exams.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this subtitle, an applicant for a master plumber license or a journey plumber license shall pass an examination given by the Board under this subtitle.

exams.name: Journeyman Natural Gas Fitters License Examination
exams.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this subtitle, an applicant for a journeyman natural gas fitters license shall pass an examination given by the Board under this subtitle.

exams.name: Backflow Prevention Devices Training
exams.notes: 32 hours of training in testing of backflow prevention devices required for journey and master plumber applicants.
exams.quote: shall have completed at least 32 hours of training in the testing of backflow prevention devices, in a manner approved by the Board.

interval_years.quote: unless a license is renewed for a 2–year term as provided in this section, the license expires on the first May 1 that comes

available.quote: the Board may waive the examination requirements for a master plumber license or a journey plumber license for an individual who is licensed to provide plumbing services in another state

requirements.value: Board may waive examination requirements on affirmative vote of majority of authorized membership if applicant pays fee, holds active equivalent license in good standing in another state, and that state waives examination for Maryland licensees to a similar extent. Applicant must meet all other Maryland qualifications.
requirements.quote: The Board may grant a waiver under this section only if an applicant: (1) pays the appropriate fee required under § 12–306 of this subtitle; and (2) provides adequate evidence that the applicant: (i) meets the qualifications otherwise required by this title; (ii) holds an active license in good standing in the other state; (iii) holds a license that is equivalent to the State license; and (iv) became licensed in the other state after meeting requirements that are at least equivalent to the licensing requirements of this State.

exists.quote: There is a State Board of Plumbing in the Department.

national_certification.quote: hold a current certification of completion of the National Propane Gas Association Certified Training Program for Distribution Systems Operations

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not provide, attempt to provide, or offer to provide plumbing services unless licensed by the Board to provide plumbing services.

title_protection.quote: Unless authorized under this title to provide plumbing services, a person may not represent to the public, by use of a title, including "master plumber", "registered plumber", "licensed master plumber", "holder of limited master plumber license", "licensed journey plumber", "journey plumber"

scope_protection.quote: a person may not provide, attempt to provide, or offer to provide plumbing services unless licensed by the Board to provide plumbing services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or licensee or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct while providing plumbing services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct while providing plumbing services or assisting in providing plumbing services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the State Plumbing Code or applicable local plumbing code while providing services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of violating the State Plumbing Code or applicable local plumbing code while providing plumbing services or assisting in providing plumbing services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or relevant misdemeanor under US or state law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: under the laws of the United States or of any state, is convicted of: 1. a felony; or 2. a misdemeanor that is directly related to the fitness and qualification of the applicant or licensee to provide plumbing services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of an unfair or deceptive trade practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of an unfair or deceptive trade practice, as defined in § 13-301 of the Commercial Law Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately train and control persons under the master plumber's direction who sell, estimate, or provide plumbing services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to train and control adequately any person who, while under the direction and control of the master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license, sells or gives estimates for providing plumbing services or provides or assists in providing plumbing services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain required liability insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to maintain the liability insurance required under § 12-501 of this title for a master plumber, holder of a limited master plumber license who contracts to provide plumbing services on behalf of the master plumber, holder of a limited master plumber license, or another, holder of a propane gas fitter certificate, or holder of a master natural gas fitters license
is guilty of violating § 12-605 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing services outside the scope of the licensee's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: as the holder of a limited license, propane gas fitter certificate, master natural gas fitters license, journey plumber license, journeyman natural gas fitters license, apprentice plumber license, or apprentice natural gas fitters license, performs plumbing, propane gas fitting, or natural gas fitting services outside the scope of that license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly allowing another licensee to perform services outside their license scope
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly allows or permits another licensee to perform plumbing, propane gas fitting, or natural gas fitting services outside the scope of that individual's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any other provision of the title or any regulation adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates any other provision of this title; or violates any regulation adopted under this title

bonding_required.quote: If a county, municipal corporation, special taxing district, or other political subdivision requires a master plumber, holder of a limited master plumber license, or other person who engages in the business of providing plumbing services to execute a surety bond under local plumbing requirements, the person may satisfy the bond requirement by submitting proof of the insurance required under this section.

insurance_required.quote: A master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license may not contract to provide plumbing services on behalf of the master plumber, holder of a limited master plumber license, or another person who engages in the business of providing plumbing services unless the plumbing work of the master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license is covered by liability insurance, including completed operations

definition_quote.value: "Provide plumbing services" means to install, maintain, extend, alter, or remove piping, a plumbing fixture, a plumbing appliance, a plumbing appurtenance, or other plumbing apparatus: (i) within or adjacent to a building, structure, or property; and (ii) in connection with: 1. a public or private disposal system, sanitary drainage facility, or storm drainage facility; 2. a venting system; or 3. a public or private water supply system.
definition_quote.quote: "Provide plumbing services" means to install, maintain, extend, alter, or remove piping, a plumbing fixture, a plumbing appliance, a plumbing appurtenance, or other plumbing apparatus: (i) within or adjacent to a building, structure, or property; and (ii) in connection with: 1. a public or private disposal system, sanitary drainage facility, or storm drainage facility; 2. a venting system; or 3. a public or private water supply system.

methods_authorized.quote: "Provide plumbing services" means to install, maintain, extend, alter, or remove piping, a plumbing fixture, a plumbing appliance, a plumbing appurtenance, or other plumbing apparatus

license_tiers.quote: "License" includes, unless the context requires otherwise, each of the following licenses: (i) a master plumber license; (ii) a journey plumber license; (iii) an apprentice plumber license; (iv) a limited license; (v) a propane gas fitter certificate; (vi) a master natural gas fitters license; (vii) a journeyman natural gas fitters license; and (viii) an apprentice natural gas fitters license.

residential_scope_limited.quote: While a limited master plumber license is in effect, it authorizes the licensee to provide plumbing services only in a specified geographical area of the State.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: An apprentice plumber may assist in providing plumbing services only under the direction and control of a master plumber or a holder of a limited master plumber license.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: While an apprentice plumber license is in effect, it authorizes the licensee to assist in providing plumbing services only under the direction and control of a master plumber or a holder of a limited master plumber license.

master_plumber_supervisory_experience_re.quote: shall have completed at least 3,750 hours of training in providing plumbing services as a journey plumber licensed in this State or another state and under the direction and control of a licensed master plumber

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: the Board may waive the examination requirements for a master plumber license or a journey plumber license for an individual who is licensed to provide plumbing services in another state on the affirmative vote of at least a majority of the authorized membership of the Board.

gas_supply_work_included_in_scope.quote: "Provide plumbing services" includes installing, repairing, servicing, and replacing gas piping, gas utilization equipment, and associated accessories.

natural_gas_appliance_certification_requ.quote: Subsection (a)(3) and (4) of this section does not apply to an individual licensed by the State Board of Heating, Ventilation, Air-Conditioning, and Refrigeration Contractors while servicing an existing propane gas or existing natural gas appliance if the individual has completed a manufacturer's training course certifying competence to work on that particular type of appliance.

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: "providing plumbing services" does not include using piping, equipment, or material only for: ... (iii) the installation, alteration, repair, or removal of an automatic sprinkler system, related apparatus, or standpipe that is used only for fire protection

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: A person may engage in the business of providing plumbing services if: (1) the person is a master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license; or (2) the person: (i) designates a master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license who actively directs, controls, and is responsible for all plumbing services

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: This section does not apply to an employee of a building owner, manager, or maintenance company who provides plumbing services that the Board defines by regulation to be only minor plumbing repair services.
